items.title: 구찌, 2026 가을·겨울 아이웨어 새 시선
items.summary: Money Today covers Gucci's newly unveiled 2026 fall-winter eyewear campaign, shot by photographer Mark Seliger with art direction by Riccardo Zanola. Portraits center on figures in contemplative solo moments wearing Double-G acetate frames and Horsebit-detailed round sunglasses; standard brand-activation PR coverage, not independently reported opinion.

items.source: PR TIMES (Kering Japan press release, via Fashion Press)
items.title: 【GUCCI】グッチ アイウェア 2026年秋冬コレクションの新キャンペーンを発表
items.summary: Kering Japan's official press release announcing the same fall/winter eyewear campaign for the Japanese market, confirming a September 14 Japan release date ahead of the September 17 Korean media pickup -- useful for timing the activation's regional rollout sequence.

items.title: 古驰突然大降价：最高降40%！经典款跌破万元，还能买吗？
items.summary: Chinese finance/product-review Weibo account breaks down Gucci's China discount list by product line (Ophidia mini bucket bag, GG Marmont bucket bag, Mercato tote), framing the cuts as Kering trading price for volume. Thread advises buyers that most discounted styles will not hold resale value, reflecting bargain-hunting rather than brand-loyalty sentiment. No visible like/comment/share counts on the page.

items.title: 最高降幅超40%！古驰Gucci多款包包成衣罕见降价
items.summary: Chinese shopping-deals community post itemizes the Gucci China price cuts and invites reader comment on whether now is a good time to buy, illustrating community-channel discussion driven by bargain-hunting rather than brand enthusiasm. No visible engagement metrics on fetch.

items.title: 구찌와 함께한 리노 x 하퍼스바자 화보
items.summary: Official Stray Kids fan-facing account posted a Lee Know x Gucci pictorial produced with Harper's Bazaar, tied to his role as Gucci global brand ambassador. Represents fandom-amplified brand content rather than organic press coverage; engagement figures not accessible via public fetch (X blocks unauthenticated scraping).

items.title: 리노 얼굴이 구찌 특유의 감각을 잘 살린다는 팬 반응
items.summary: Korean fan account post praising how Lee Know's features suit Gucci's 'restrained decadence' aesthetic, ending with '결론, 리노 하트 구찌' (conclusion: Lee Know loves Gucci). Representative organic fandom sentiment around the ambassador tie-up rather than brand-issued content; engagement counts not retrievable via public fetch.

items.title: グッチは業績の立て直しに向けて動き出したのか？
items.summary: FashionNetwork Japan assesses whether Gucci's turnaround is taking hold: H1 2026 revenue fell 9% reported / 5% comparable, narrowing from an 8% Q1 decline to 2% in Q2 -- a 6-point sequential improvement Kering attributes to early effects of the CEO/creative-director reset. Balanced framing: improvement is real but revenue base remains far below 2022 peak (down over EUR 4.5bn since 2022).

items.title: Stray Kids リノ「GUCCI」のグローバルアンバサダーに抜擢!活動に期待高まる
items.summary: Japanese aggregator picks up the Lee Know x Gucci global ambassador story for the Japanese fan audience, noting anticipation for his upcoming brand activities. Illustrates continued cross-market (KR to JP) media amplification of the K-pop ambassador tie-up.

items.title: 명품 갤러리 - 구찌 가격 정책 신뢹성 논쟁 스레드
items.summary: Korean community board (DCInside luxury gallery) continues threads comparing Gucci's China discounting against its history of Korea-only price hikes, with posters questioning why Korean consumers do not receive comparable cuts and calling past hikes '배짱장사' (price-gouging). Board-level aggregate observed rather than a single measurable thread; illustrates ongoing community skepticism about pricing fairness.

items.title: 古驰地震：Demna上任、降价40%、关店百间，品牌转向何方？
items.summary: Chinese explainer synthesizes three concurrent Gucci shifts -- Demna's creative-director tenure since March 2025, China price cuts approaching 40% on select bags, and roughly 75 store closures in 2025 (about 30 of them outlets) with another 100 planned for 2026 -- framing the combination as trading design novelty and price for volume at the risk of diluting brand prestige. Critical-angle piece questioning whether the strategy can restore Gucci's standing.
